summarization: This smartphone UI screen is for an application called "Sex Offender Tracker." The main purpose of the app is to help users find registered sex offenders living in their neighborhood. The screen features a dark background with a map and a red location pin highlighted by a spotlight effect. Below the app's title, there is a prompt that reads, "Find registered sex offenders living in your neighborhood." At the bottom of the screen, there are two input fields where users can either enter their email or phone number to proceed. The two input fields are separated by a red circle with the word "OR" in it.
